questions.question: Which dance style is strongly associated with structured pointe work and codified positions?
Which style uses shoes with taps to create rhythmic sounds?
Hip-hop dance developed within a broader culture that includes
choices: music, movement, visual expression, and community practices

questions.question: Which description best fits jazz dance as practiced in many stage settings?
choices: A single dance with one universal step list
A form limited to partner ballroom
A style drawing on African American cultural roots and evolving through varied theatrical forms

questions.question: What is a common feature of contemporary dance?
choices: Artists combine and adapt movement ideas from multiple traditions and techniques
It follows one universal codified syllabus
It must be performed in silence

questions.question: Which description best fits a waltz in ballroom dance?
choices: A partner dance commonly organized in triple meter
A sequence of ballet barre exercises

questions.question: Why is it inaccurate to describe a dance style as having only one correct form?
choices: Styles change across communities, artists, time periods, and contexts

questions.question: A performance combines breaking, house, and locking. What does this illustrate?
choices: Every style has the same history
A dance work can draw from multiple styles

questions.question: What is one useful way to identify a style in a performance?
choices: Notice movement qualities, musical relationships, and relevant cultural context
Assume every fast dance is hip-hop

questions.question: Which practice is common in ballet class to develop balance and technique?
choices: Tap shoes used for percussive sound
A circle dance at a community gathering

questions.question: What should a student do when learning a dance from a culture outside their own?
choices: Treat it as a costume theme
Assume all members of the culture dance alike
Learn its context and sources, and approach the practice respectfully

questions.question: Which description best fits a folk or social dance?
choices: A dance that can never change
A style performed only by professionals
A dance connected to community practices and social participation

questions.question: A work uses ballet training but breaks from traditional ballet structure. What can be said?
choices: It may draw on ballet technique while developing a different choreographic approach
It must follow a ballet story

questions.question: What does 'fusion' suggest when describing a dance work?
choices: The work combines movement approaches from more than one style or tradition
The work uses one fixed tradition only
The work is a written review

questions.question: Which style commonly uses isolations of body parts and grounded rhythmic movement?
Why should students learn the historical roots of jazz and hip-hop dance?
choices: Context helps recognize the communities and innovations that shaped the styles

questions.question: A dance is performed to music in triple meter with a turning partner pattern. Which style is a likely match?
Which statement about contemporary dance is strongest?
choices: It is a broad, evolving field rather than a single uniform vocabulary

questions.question: What is a responsible way to compare two dance traditions?
choices: Describe movement features and consider each tradition's own context

questions.question: A performance includes rhythmic footwork, improvisation, and direct audience interaction. Which clue is most useful for style analysis?
choices: Assume the performance has no tradition
Consider the movement, musical relationship, and performance context together
